items.title: 26.5 Ghair tehleel pazeer polymers ka masla (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the challenge of non-degradable polymers (PDF 155).

blocks.text: Poly(ethene) jaise plastics duniya mein sab se zyada use hone wale polymer maadde hain. Riwayati poly(alkene) plastics ghair tehleel pazeer hain: yeh saada, ghair zehreele compounds mein nahi toot'te. Is wajah se phenkne ke baad yeh mahol ke liye museebat bante aur paani, mitti aur jaandaaron ke maskanon mein pohanch jate hain. Plastic ka kachra zameen mein dabaya jata ya, jahan baladiyati nizam kamzor ho, khule mein chhor diya jata hai.

items: Yeh mahol mein bohat lambe arse rehte aur landfills, samandaron aur qudrati manazir mein jama hote hain.
Yeh landfills ki bohat jagah gherte hain, jo aabadi barhne ke saath milna mushkil hoti hai.
Jaanwar, khaas kar samandari, plastic ko khana samajh lete hain, jis se dam ghutna, andaruni zakhm ya bhookh hoti hai, aur plastic ke kachre mein ulajh jate hain.
Bare tukre dheere dheere chhote microplastics mein toot'te hain, jo mitti, paani aur hawa mein phailte, khurak ki zanjeer mein dakhil hote aur insani sehat ko nuqsan de sakte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ghair tehleel pazeer polymers ki taareef 'jo saada, ghair zehreele compounds mein toot sakte hain' karti hai. Baat ulti hai: ghair tehleel pazeer polymers is tarah nahi toot sakte.

Poly(alkene)s kimiyai taur par be-asar hain, kyunke in ki zanjeeron mein sirf mazboot, non-polar C-C aur C-H bonds hain, is liye in ki biodegradation mushkil hai. Is ne degradable polymers ki do qismon ko janam diya: biodegradable aur photodegradable.

blocks.prompt: Poly(alkene)s ki biodegradation itni mushkil kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: In mein sirf mazboot, non-polar C-C aur C-H bonds hain, koi polar group (jaise ester ya amide links) nahi jis par paani ya khurdbeeni jaandaar hamla kar sakein.

items: Poly(alkene)s be-asar aur der pa: landfill, kachra, jaanwaron ko nuqsan, microplastics.
